articles.title: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
articles.summary: Anthropic is hiring fewer and fewer junior staff in technical roles. The share of junior positions among new hires dropped from 27 to 9 percent since early 2025. By August 2026, AI agents across the company were already logging six times as many hours as humans.
